objective: Corroborate the semantics of Spain-facing Jackpot King base RTP independently from jackpot contribution/hazard, using another licensed Spanish operator's regulatory RTP disclosure.

regulatorySemantics.interpretation: The bet365 Spain disclosure explicitly states that amounts allocated to jackpots are excluded from the disclosed RTP calculations. This makes its theoretical RTP an independent Spain-facing ex-jackpot/base-return comparator for exact-title matches.

scientificImplications: For these two exact-title Spain-facing Jackpot King games, a second licensed Spanish operator publishes the same theoretical RTP values that Botemania labels as Base, while explicitly excluding jackpot-assigned amounts from the RTP calculations.
This materially strengthens the interpretation of 95.46% and 94.50% as ex-jackpot/base-return values rather than total returns including the progressive component.

The six monthly actual returns are operator-specific realized returns excluding jackpots; they are useful for configuration-drift and activity research, not transferable expected returns for Botemania.
Matching base RTP across operators does not prove equal reel strips, trigger probabilities, downstream Wheel King probabilities, contribution rates, jackpot pool membership or final hazard per EUR.
